## 🎵 TikTok Video Downloader (No Watermark)

Looking for a **TikTok video downloader** for Node.js? This package downloads TikTok videos **without watermark** in HD quality, plus MP3 audio extraction — no login, no cookies, no API keys required. One of the fastest `tiktok-downloader` npm packages with automatic fallback across multiple sources.

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');
const video = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123456');
console.log(video.url); // HD, no watermark
```

## 🛡️ Never-Down Fallback System (v2.9.0)

Every platform has an **ordered chain of independent sources**. If one API goes down, the next takes over automatically — you never see the failure.

```js
const alldl = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

// Works even if the primary TikTok API is down —
// the chain tries tikwm → ssstik → tiktokio → nntech → downbloder → direct scrape
const video = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123');
```

**Self-healing sources:** a source that fails 3 times in a row is skipped for 10 minutes (cooldown), then automatically retried. Flaky APIs stop slowing you down.

```js
// Inspect source health
console.log(alldl.sourceHealth());
// { "tiktok:tikwm": { fails: 0, inCooldown: false }, "youtube:piped1": { fails: 3, inCooldown: true, cooldownEndsInMs: 420000 } }

// Probe every source (for debugging — never throws)
const status = await alldl.checkSources();
// { tiktok: { "tiktok:tikwm": "up", "tiktok:ssstik": "up", ... }, youtube: { ... } }
```

**Sources per platform (v2.12.0):** TikTok 6 · YouTube 5 · Twitter/X 3 · Snapchat 2 · TeraBox 2 · Kwai 2 · CapCut 3 · Moj 2 · Likee 2 · Reddit 3 · Pinterest 2 · Josh 2 · Facebook 2 · Instagram 2 · Rumble 2 · Twitch 2 · Vimeo 2 · Dailymotion 2 · Threads 2 · GDrive 1 · MEGA 1 · MediaFire 1 · Bilibili 1 · SoundCloud 1 · Spotify 1 · Douyin 1 · Xiaohongshu 1 · Deezer 1 · Apple Music 1 · Bandcamp 1 · Pixeldrain 1 · Gofile 1 · Odysee 1 · PeerTube 1 · Kick 1 · VK 1 · Weibo 1 · Mixcloud 1 · Audiomack 1 — all free, no keys, no login.

## 🔎 Looking for a Video Downloader?

**rahad-all-downloader-v2** is an all-in-one media downloader for Node.js. If you searched for any of these, you're in the right place:

### TikTok Video Downloader
Download TikTok videos without watermark in HD, plus TikTok MP3 audio extraction — no login required.

### Instagram Video Downloader
Download Instagram Reels, posts and IGTV videos in high quality without logging in.

### Facebook Video Downloader
Download Facebook videos in HD & SD quality with a single function call.

### YouTube Video Downloader
Download YouTube videos and Shorts with automatic fallback for maximum reliability.

### Twitter / X Video Downloader
Download X (Twitter) videos and photos in multiple qualities.

### Snapchat, Pinterest, Threads, Likee, CapCut & Kwai Downloader
Also supports Snapchat Spotlight & Stories, Pinterest, Threads, Likee, CapCut, Kwai, Reddit, Moj, Josh, Rumble, Twitch, Streamable, Tumblr, Bluesky, Loom, Rutube, OK.ru, BitChute and more — 54 platforms in one lightweight package.

## 🚀 Quick Start

One function handles everything — it auto-detects the platform from the URL:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

(async () => {
  const result = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890');

  console.log(result.data.title);    // "Funny cat video 🐱"
  console.log(result.data.videoUrl); // "https://.../download.mp4" — direct link!
  console.log(result.data.source);   // "TikTok"
})();
```

## ℹ️ Video Info (no download)

Get only metadata without downloading — title, author, thumbnail, duration:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

const meta = await alldl.info('https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame/video/7081291571970329861');
console.log(meta);
// {
//   site: 'tiktok',
//   platform: 'tiktok',          // alias of site — consistent shape on every site
//   url: 'https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame/video/7081291571970329861',
//   title: 'He doesn’t want to be my friend 😢🥺 ...',
//   author: { name: 'Khabane lame', url: 'https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame' },
//   uploader: 'Khabane lame',    // flat alias of author.name
//   thumbnail: 'https://p16-common-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/...',  // ⚠️ signed URL — expires!
//   duration: 34,       // seconds, null if unavailable
//   description: '...'
// }

// For Facebook / Instagram, an app token is required (your own — never hardcode):
const fbMeta = await alldl.info('https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=123', { appToken: 'APP_ID|APP_SECRET' });
```

**Field availability per site** (✅ = available, ➖ = null). Every result also
carries `platform` (alias of `site`) and `uploader` (alias of `author.name`):

| Site | title | author | thumbnail | duration | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (maxres) | ✅ | ➖ |
| TikTok | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (⚠️ expires) | ✅ | ✅ (= title) |
| Vimeo | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Facebook* | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Instagram* | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Pinterest | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ |
| Dailymotion | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (views) |
| Reddit | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ |
| Moj | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Josh | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Rumble | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Twitch | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ |
| Others / unknown | ✅ (og:) | ➖ | ✅ (og:) | ➖ | ✅ (og:) |

\* `appToken` required — returns an honest error without it.

## ⬇️ Download to Disk

Save directly to disk as a file, with progress callback:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

const file = await alldl.download(
  'https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890',
  './videos/', // folder → auto filename from title; file path → used as-is
  {
    onProgress: ({ percent, done, total }) =>
      console.log(`Downloading... ${percent ?? '?'}%`),
  }
);

console.log(file.path);  // "./videos/Funny cat video.mp4"
console.log(file.bytes); // file size in bytes
```

### 🎚️ Quality Selector

```js
// named: best (default) | high | medium | low | worst | audio
const r = await alldl('TIKTOK_URL', { quality: 'high' });
const file = await alldl.download('FB_URL', './videos/', { quality: 'medium' });

// explicit heights — closest stream at or under the target (never upscale);
// when nothing fits under it, the smallest stream above it
const hd = await alldl('X_URL', { quality: '720p' });
const fhd = await alldl.download('REDDIT_URL', './videos/', { quality: '1080p' });
const bare = await alldl('VIMEO_URL', { quality: 720 }); // bare number works too

// height cap — highest stream with height <= maxHeight
const capped = await alldl('REDDIT_URL', { maxHeight: 480 });
```

The same values work on the CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" -q 720p`

### 🎵 Audio Only (MP3)

```js
const song = await alldl.download('TIKTOK_URL', './music/', { audioOnly: true });
// → "./music/Video title.mp3" (TikTok music, Kwai audio, YouTube audio)
```

```bash
npx rahad-all-downloader-v2 "<url>" --resume  # resume an interrupted download
npx rahad-dl --proxy http://user:pass@host:port "<url>"  # via proxy (comma-separated = rotate)
npx rahad-dl --batch "<url1>" "<url2>" "<url3>" -o ./batch  # many URLs at once
npx rahad-dl --batch-file ./urls.txt -o ./batch  # one URL per line in a file
```

## 🚀 Serve Mode — Your Own Downloader API

One command. Self-hosted API + web UI. No Cobalt deploy, no Python.

```bash
npx rahad-all-downloader-v2 serve --port 3000
# with API key + proxy:
npx rahad-all-downloader-v2 serve --port 3000 --api-key SECRET --proxy http://user:pass@host:port
```

Then open http://localhost:3000 — beautiful web UI, paste any link and download.

**REST API:**
| Method | Endpoint | Body |
|--------|----------|------|
| POST | `/api/download` | `{ url, quality, audioOnly }` → `{ title, source, videoUrl }` |
| POST | `/api/info` | `{ url }` → metadata |
| GET | `/api/file?url=` | streams the file with nice filename |
| GET | `/api/health` | `{ status: "ok" }` |

API key (optional): send `x-api-key` header or `?key=` param.

```js
// programmatic:
const server = await alldl.serve({ port: 3000, apiKey: 'SECRET' });

// proxy for geo-blocked content:
alldl.setProxy('http://user:pass@host:port');

// rotate proxies round-robin (auto-switch on each request):
alldl.setProxy(['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080']);
console.log(alldl.getProxy()); // ['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080']
alldl.setProxy(null); // disable

// per-request proxy (overrides global, concurrency-safe):
await alldl.download('VIDEO_URL', './', { proxy: 'http://p3:8080' });
```

## 📋 Playlist Download

```js
const pl = await alldl.playlist('YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_URL');
console.log(pl.title, pl.count); // 25 videos

// TikTok user profiles work too:
const tk = await alldl.playlist('https://www.tiktok.com/@username', { limit: 30 });

// Instagram carousel/album posts → every media item (videos + photos):
const ig = await alldl.playlist('https://www.instagram.com/p/SHORTCODE/', { limit: 10 });
for (const item of ig.videos) {
  // item.mediaUrl is a direct CDN URL — download it without re-resolving:
  await alldl._downloadDirect(item.mediaUrl, './carousel/', {}, { title: item.title, source: 'Instagram' });
}

for (const v of pl.videos) {
  await alldl.download(v.url, './playlist/');
}
```

Playlist entries carry `{ videoId, title, url }`; Instagram carousel entries
add `mediaUrl` (a direct CDN URL) so they can be fetched without resolving.

## 📝 Subtitles (.srt)

```js
const sub = await alldl.subtitles('YOUTUBE_URL', { lang: 'bn', dest: './subs/' });
console.log(sub.path); // "./subs/Video title.bn.srt"
```

## 📚 Batch Download

Many URLs at once — if one fails, the rest keep going:

```js
const results = await alldl.batch(
  ['TIKTOK_URL', 'IG_URL', 'YT_URL'],
  {
    concurrency: 3, // max concurrent requests
    onItem: (item, i) => console.log(i, item.success ? 'done' : item.error),
  }
);
// results[i] = { success: true, url, metadata, data } or { success: false, url, error }

// Or feed URLs from a file (one per line; # comments and blanks skipped):
//   rahad-dl --batch-file ./urls.txt -o ./videos
// → resolves + downloads each with concurrency 3, prints per-URL ✅/❌ lines
//   and a final "X succeeded, Y failed" summary.
```

## 🔁 Auto-Retry & Quality Preference

```js
// Retries transient failures twice (with backoff)
const r = await alldl('TIKTOK_URL', { retries: 2 });

// X/Twitter: for 720p, selects the closest quality at or below it
const x = await alldl.x('X_URL', { quality: '720p' });

// Slow network? Raise the API timeout (default 20000ms)
alldl.setTimeout(45000);
console.log(alldl.getTimeout()); // 45000
```

## 📘 TypeScript & ESM

Full type definitions ship with the package. Native ESM works out of the box:

```ts
import { alldl } from 'rahad-all-downloader-v2';

const res = await alldl('https://vt.tiktok.com/XXXX/');
const url: string = res.data.videoUrl; // fully typed ✅
```

---

## ⚙️ Error Handling

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

try {
  const result = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890');
  // use result.data.videoUrl
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Download failed:', error.message);
}
```

---

## ❓ FAQ

<details>
<summary><b>Do I need an API key or login?</b></summary>
<br>
No. The package works out of the box — no API keys, no cookies, no login required.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Does it remove the TikTok watermark?</b></summary>
<br>
Yes. TikTok videos are extracted in HD without any watermark.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Which Node.js versions are supported?</b></summary>
<br>
Node.js 16 and above.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Can I use it with TypeScript / ESM?</b></summary>
<br>
Yes. Type definitions (<code>index.d.ts</code>) and native ESM (<code>index.mjs</code>) are included.
</details>
